name: BehaviourIncidentLogger
tagline: Log positive and concern incidents, notify parents and spot escalation – on any device.
description: Pastoral behaviour log PCF control for schools: multi-student incident recording with points, location, witnesses, action and follow-up, severity-driven parent notification and witness rules, day-grouped log with filters, student points board with 14-day trends, escalation thresholds and award milestones, status workflow and follow-up notes. Works in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Multi-student record form with category chips and policy validation
Parent notification required by severity, with method and 'mark notified'
Incident log grouped by day with filters and badges
Student points board with sparkline, escalation and awards
Open → Action taken → Resolved workflow and follow-up notes
Phone bottom sheets, tablet dialog, desktop side panel
Configurable labels, colours, locations, actions and thresholds
13 outputs and a Power Pages DOM event
